title: Summer High School Internship Program (SHIP)
organization: NIST (National Institute of Standards and Technology)
description: A seven-week, unpaid educational summer internship in NIST labs at the Gaithersburg, MD or Boulder, CO campus, for high school juniors and seniors interested in scientific research.
unstructured_requirements: Permanent residence within a 50-mile radius of the host campus (NIST Boulder or NIST Gaithersburg)
Must commit to the full seven-week program
Students and parent(s)/guardian(s) provide their own housing and transportation
Two letters of recommendation (one from a STEM teacher) and a one-page personal statement

min_grade.quote: be a high school junior or senior at time of application

max_grade.quote: be a high school junior or senior at time of application

min_gpa.quote: have a minimum unweighted GPA of 3.0 on a 4.0 scale

is_paid.quote: SHIP is a seven-week, unpaid educational internship.
